name: finance-skill-foundry-app
description: Desktop surface for the finance skill foundry: tasks, their inputs, and every version of what they produced

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.package: npm run harness:check && npm run foundry:check && npm run formulator:check && npm run formulator:gate && npm run clean:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir --arm64
scripts.package:signed: npm run harness:check && npm run foundry:check && npm run formulator:check && npm run formulator:gate && npm run clean:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir --arm64 -c.mac.identity="$CSC_NAME" -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=true -c.mac.gatekeeperAssess=false -c.mac.entitlements=signing/entitlements.mac.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=signing/entitlements.mac.plist -c.mac.sign=signing/sign-macho-only.cjs
scripts.dist: npm run harness:check && npm run foundry:check && npm run formulator:check && npm run formulator:gate && npm run clean:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
